description.sub_name: 魔幻新世界：走進拉丁美洲
description.sub_ename: MAGICAL NEW WORLD: ENTERING LATIN AMERICA
description.describe_ch: 藉由對拉丁美洲地理、歷史、文化以及風俗習慣等議題之講解與導讀以及報告之撰寫讓同學瞭解拉丁美洲之概況，俾使有志從事外交、新聞及經貿同學具備認識拉丁美洲事務之基礎素養。
description.describe_eh: Through explanations and readings on Latin American geography, history, culture, customs and habits, as well as report writing, students can understand the general situation of Latin America, so that students who are interested in pursuing a career in diplomacy, journalism and trade will have the basic qualities to understand Latin American affairs.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
課堂規則Course Policies
1. Respect: You are encouraged to attend class regularly and participate in class activities, but don’t monopolize conversations. Disrespectful comments or behavior will not be tolerated. Please contact me immediately if you ever feel like the class atmosphere is not respectful toward you or your peers. On speech day, kindly remember to listen at the classroom door before entering. Never, never, never enter the classroom while a student or guest is speaking. Don’t ever sleep in class, either. Please respect each other and your instructor.
  尊重：請準時出席每堂課並參與課堂活動，但請不要壟斷課程討論或對話。對他人的不尊重評論或行為將不被容忍。如果你覺得課堂氛圍對你或同學不尊重，請立即聯繫我。在同學演講當日，請記得在進入教室之前先在門口傾聽，不要在學生或他人發言時進入教室。上課時也請不要睡覺，請尊重你的同學與教師。
2. Technology: Phones must be put away during class. Tablet or laptop computers may be used for class-related material and note-taking. I may change this policy if computers become distracting.
  電子設備：上課期間必須將手機收起。可以使用平板電腦或筆記型電腦進行與課堂相關的活動和做筆記。如果因為使用電腦而分散了注意力，我可能會修改此規則。
3. Attendance: Attendance is counted from the first week. Please be aware that skipping classes will jeopardize your overall course grade. Also, sleeping in class is regarded as an absence. 
  課堂出席：學生出席狀況從第一周開始紀錄，缺課將影響你的課程總成績。此外，上課時睡覺將視為缺席。
4. Missed Speeches/ Late assignments: No late or makeup work will not be accepted unless in the event of a documented emergency.
  演講未到/遲交作業：除非在緊急情況下(須提供證明文件)，否則不接受任何遲交或補交的作業。
5. Academic Integrity: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work (including AI tools) without full acknowledgement is considered plagiarism. 
  學術誠信：必須正確引用來源。未經適當引用而複製或使用他人作品(包括AI工具產出的內容)將被視為抄襲。

課程提醒 Course Friendly Reminder
1.	Be on time.請準時。
2.	Participate in class discussion and class activities. 參與課堂討論和活動。
3.	Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expecte duration. 學生必須提前向學校請假，並說明請假的理由和預計時長。
4.	Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版教科書，遵守智慧財產權法。
5.	Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the exam date. Relevant documents are required for the application. No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor.按照學校規定，申請補考需在考試日期後的三天內，申請時需提供相關文件。缺考或延遲申請補考者將以零分計算，補考的日期將由教師安排。
6.	Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward and Disciplinary Committee. 根據逢甲考試規章，作弊者以零分計算，而且相關案件將送交學生獎懲委員會審核。
